description: This file declares structures and a class for parsing H.265 (HEVC) video stream NAL units, specifically handling Annex-B format and NALU identification.

classes.name: media::H265NALU
classes.description: Represents an H.265 NAL unit with type, data pointer, size, and identifiers.

classes.name: media::H265NaluParser
classes.description: Parses an Annex-B formatted H.265 stream to extract NAL units.

methods.name: H265NaluParser::AdvanceToNextNALU
methods.description: Advances the parser to the next NAL unit in the stream and returns its information.

methods.name: H265NaluParser::SetStream
methods.description: Sets the current stream to parse, with optional encryption info.

methods.name: H265NaluParser::SetEncryptedStream
methods.description: Sets the stream with encryption details.

methods.name: H265NaluParser::GetCurrentSubsamples
methods.description: Returns subsample encryption info for the current NALU.
